site.title: Saad Bhatti's Studio
site.intro: Howdy, I'm Saad Bhatti. Welcome to my studio. Feel free to explore my work.
bio: I'm Saad Bhatti, Software Engineer by trade, Creative at heart.
I've been shooting film for a few years on my film cameras, and have collected a few of my photos here that I would like y'all to see and enjoy!
I've also expanded my creative pursuits to include Painting, mostly in Oil. So look out for those some time soon!
Feel free to inquire about prints! I'm trying to set a little business up.
